text:
sam: Quick sync — prepping a sprint dry-run for the pen-test (wednesday). Need RBAC snapshot, KMS read-only window, and an audit-log sampling plan. Who can own the ops handshake?
laura: I can own RBAC snapshot. Will produce role diff + mapping to services. ETA EOD Mon.
andre: I can coordinate KMS window. Quick question — do we need any HSM-level exports or just temporary decrypt grants for the readroom export? :thinking:
sam: @andre just temporary grants. No key material export. Use KMS Grant + ephemeral role. Devops will stand up a proxy for the assessor sessions.
tia: For audit logs: prefer continuous export for auth/key events. For everything else propose 1:10 sampling to reduce noise. Full retention for auth/KMS.
laura: Agreed. Also adding a post-readroom rotate step for the "assessor" role so nothing remains open. I'll add into playbook.
dev-ops-bot: deploy-kms-proxy job created: https://ci.internal/jobs/7890 — proxy will create ephemeral grants and emit session tags. Config snippet: ```yaml
jobs:
  deploy-kms-proxy:
    image: infra/tools:latest
    steps:
      - run: ./deploy proxy --env staging --ttl 3600
```
andre: Need to confirm ephemeral role TTL. Can we support 1h TTL with session_tag in audit events? @tia @laura
tia: Yes — 1h TTL ok. CloudTrail will include session tags. Example lookup: ```bash
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=assessor-session
```
sam: I'll create the JIRA board and retest slots, and wire the remediation tracker to vuln IDs. Need owners mapped to PRs and deploy windows.
laura: I'll attach the RBAC diff and a sample log export to the issue. Reminder to run role-deny tests after changes: ```bash
./tools/rbac-checker --policy assessor --env staging
```
andre: Ok. Oncall: please confirm dry-run coverage. @mike can you be oncall next Wed for quick smoke checks?
sam: Action items recap — laura: RBAC diff + rotate playbook; andre: KMS grant + proxy job; tia: audit sampling + CloudTrail tags; sam: JIRA board + retest slots. Reconvene Mon 10:00am to validate. :thumbsup:
